description: This file contains Perl code that generates optimized assembly implementations of the ChaCha20 cipher for x86 architectures, including SSE2 and SSSE3 optimized routines, with performance benchmarks and platform-specific code paths.

methods.name: QUARTERROUND
methods.description: Performs the quarter-round operation of the ChaCha20 cipher, manipulating four state words with rotations, XORs, and additions.

methods.name: QUARTERROUND_SSSE3
methods.description: Optimized SSSE3 version of the quarter-round operation for SIMD processing.
